mapper.update: update reservation set reservation_pay = 1 where reservation_id = #{reservation_id}
update reservation set reservation_qr = #{qrCode} where reservation_id = #{reservation_id}
mapper.select: select m.*,r.reservation_id,sum(r.reservation_price) reservation_price, r.reservation_date from reservation r left join member m on r.member_key = m.member_key where exhibition_key = #{exhibition_key} group by r.reservation_id
select * from reservation where member_key = #{member_key} and exhibition_key = #{exhibition_key} and reservation_pay = 1
mapper.update: update reservation set reservation_buyer_view = 0 where reservation_id = #{reservation_id}
